---
name: Deployment issue
about: Report a build, release, environment, or deployment problem
title: "[deployment] "
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

## Scope

Identify the target environment, artifact, revision, and deployment step.

## Reproduction or evidence

List the commands or workflow run, expected and actual result, timestamps, and
sanitized logs. Do not include secrets, endpoints with credentials, or account
data.

## Validation

State the build, test, smoke check, rollback check, or other evidence available.

## Deployment and safety impact

Could this activate, expose, or regress a user-facing service, pairing flow, or
prototype behavior? Note any rollback or manual review needed. Do not claim
physical hardware validation from a deployment result.
